exposure: Pregnant women with hypothyroxinemia not receiving L-T4 treatment
Pregnant women with hypothyroxinemia receiving L-T4 treatment
cohort: 964 pregnant women with hypothyroxinemia from the first trimester, with 463 receiving L-T4 and 501 not receiving L-T4.
finding: While L-T4 treatment did not significantly reduce the incidence of HDP in pregnant women with hypothyroxinemia, it significantly reduced the miscarriage rate and the proportion of newborns admitted to the NICU.
